title: Product Options

fields.label: Width Options
fields.name: width_options
fields.instructions: Define the available widths for this product. Each row creates a selectable option on the product page. The price for each width is entered directly — no percentages needed.

sub_fields.label: Price per metre (£)
sub_fields.name: price_per_metre
sub_fields.instructions: Actual price per linear metre at this width. Leave blank (or 0) for the base width — the product's WooCommerce regular price is used automatically.

fields.label: Roll Options
fields.name: roll_options
fields.instructions: Define the available roll lengths. Enter the actual total price for each roll at the base (narrowest) width. Other widths are priced proportionally. Leave Roll Price blank for the "Per Metre" row.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: roll_label
sub_fields.instructions: Customer-facing label, e.g. "Per Metre" or "25m Roll".

sub_fields.label: Roll Length (m)
sub_fields.name: roll_length
sub_fields.instructions: Length in metres. Use 1 for the Per Metre row.

sub_fields.label: Roll Price (£)
sub_fields.name: roll_price
sub_fields.instructions: Total price for this roll at the base width. Leave blank for the Per Metre row. If the product has multiple widths, enter the price for the narrowest — other widths scale automatically.

fields.label: Price Tiers (Quantity Discounts)
fields.name: price_tiers
fields.instructions: Optional. Define quantity break-points for per-metre purchasing. Each tier sets the price per metre when the customer orders at least the specified quantity. Tiers apply only when the customer selects "Per Metre" — fixed roll prices are not affected. Prices are stored at the base (narrowest) width; wider widths scale automatically.

sub_fields.label: Min. Quantity (m)
sub_fields.name: min_qty
sub_fields.instructions: Minimum number of metres for this tier to apply.

sub_fields.label: Price per metre (£)
sub_fields.name: tier_price
sub_fields.instructions: Price per linear metre at this quantity, at the base width. Enter the actual price — no percentages.

fields.label: Colour Swatch
fields.name: colour_hex
fields.instructions: Shown as a colour swatch on archive cards and the single product page when no product image has been uploaded. Leave blank if the product has a real image.

description: Width and roll length options that drive the ACF dynamic pricing engine. Enter actual prices — the engine handles all calculations.
